engineDefectsFound.summary: case-insensitive lstat probe treated Workspace.ts as a workspace declaration
submodule gitlinks were handed to the digester and refused as non-regular files
package-local reference resolved only at the workspace root, refusing every pnpm per-package tool
no working directory, so a package's own lint or format gate could not be expressed
the root package's empty directory rendered the setup action as .//actions/setup, which GitHub rejects

proposals.name: DocsParity
proposals.oneLine: no package-mode executor, so the synthesized docs gate is unported

proposals.name: NewPackage
proposals.oneLine: no package-mode executor and no Shell equivalent for its dynamic --name input

proposals.name: Cron
proposals.oneLine: plans but does not execute in package mode, so a scheduled lane cannot run

proposals.name: PackageDefaults
proposals.oneLine: package mode has no macro, so about twenty packages' check surfaces are hand written

proposals.name: ci/docs/install verbs
proposals.oneLine: refuse in package mode, so generated workflows call targets directly

proposals.name: CiGen self-drift
proposals.oneLine: a generated workflow cannot check its own generator for drift; naming it is a cycle

proposals.name: Github.Workflow continueOnError
proposals.oneLine: no attr for an advisory lane, so ci-faults and the host lanes are advisory by convention only

hostDrift: vendor/jj submodule is not initialized, so native Cargo targets refuse
wasm reproducibility needs x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; host is aarch64-apple-darwin
ServiceSupervisor SIGINT teardown fails under load on this host and fails identically on the unmodified base commit
